item.title: Tunnel worker was to be Schumer’s guest at State of Union as symbol of Trump’s cuts
item.description: Schumer, the Brooklyn-born lawyer, and Keogh, the Bronx-born foreman, have both been instrumental in the Hudson River Tunnel project that the Trump administration has been trying to kill.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 25, 2026
item.description: We're gaining speed as we chase our dreams! That said, the road could be a bit rough as the Moon squares Venus, potentially making small slights feel larger than they are. Fortunately, once Luna trines enthusiastic Mars at 6:00 pm EST, we can funnel the energy of those upsets into constructive action on behalf of a better future. Any verbal spats were merely clearing the air, giving everyone space to move forward without overthinking. We can accomplish our goals without trampling our peers.

item.title: Swastika drawn on wall of Coast Guard training center in New Jersey
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard has opened an internal investigation after a swastika was drawn on a bathroom wall of its recruit training station in New Jersey.

item.title: Epstein files related to Trump abuse investigation withheld by DOJ: report
item.description: The FBI reportedly investigated a woman's claims that Trump sexually abused when she was a teen, but the interviews weren't released in the Epstein files.

item.title: Creator of Squatty Potty charged with buying child pornography
item.description: Robert "Bobby" Edwards, the creator and co-founder of Squatty Potty, was arrested after the feds linked him to online accounts that bought child sex abuse material.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: He's making the case to Americans who are increasingly uneasy about his priorities.

item.title: MTA bus driver punched in the face in Brooklyn, suspect’s picture released
item.description: The 53-year-old victim was behind the wheel of a B42 bus approaching Rockaway Parkway and Flatlands Ave. in Canarsie when the suspect socked him following an argument around 5:50 p.m. on Feb. 14, according to law enforcement.

item.title: After travel chaos, Nets can’t catch Mavericks in 123-114 home loss
item.description: Brooklyn fell to the Mavericks 113-106, dropping to 15-42 and extending its losing streak to five games.

item.title: Knicks turn in season-worst scoring quarter in loss to Cavs, continue rough stretch against top east contenders
item.description: The Knick's third quarter in Cleveland may have been their worst of the last three years
